converting_recipes: Lead with the finished-result transformation, not a generic storefront shot — the buyer's real question is 'will I look like that'
Put online booking (or a clear booking CTA) above the fold — appointment-driven businesses lose buyers to friction, not price
Show real stylist/technician portfolio work over any stock image when available
Surface real client reviews near the top — beauty purchases are trust-heavy and social-proof-driven
local_seo_patterns: One H2 per real scraped service, worded as a search query (e.g. 'Balayage Hair Coloring in Park Slope')
NAP in the footer as text, not just an image, with tel: and mailto: links
LocalBusiness JSON-LD subtype matched to the business (HairSalon, BeautySalon, NailSalon, DaySpa, etc.)
facebook_ad_angles: Before/after transformation photo + 'Free instant homepage redesign, see it in 48h'
Screen-recording of the AI build happening live — the build itself is the hook
Local trust angle: 'Serving [town] since [year]' when years_in_business is a real fact
trust_signals: Real Google rating + review count from Places (never a rounded-up or invented number)
Certifications/brand partnerships (e.g. Goldwell, Aveda) only if present in scraped facts
Years in business only if stated on their existing site or provided directly
forbidden_slop: Generic handshake or laptop stock photos unrelated to beauty/salon work
Invented review counts or testimonials not present in facts
Invented certifications or brand partnerships not present in facts

photo_queries.proof: hair styling finished result close up

hero_video_cinematography: slow push-in on a finished style reveal, soft diffused window light, shallow depth of field, no readable signage
faq_seed_questions: Do I need to book in advance?
How long does an appointment take?
